_comment: Report catalog. Each sql is one parameterised SELECT/WITH. @params are bound; {{all_events}} expands to the view; @caller_app is the caller's app (cross-app credentials pass callerApp). Param types: string | timestamp | date | int64 | bool. Allotment is per client in clients.json.

reports.name: Activity summary by event type
reports.description: Event and item counts per event type / action for one app over a date range.
reports.sql: SELECT event_type, action, COUNT(*) AS events, SUM(item_count) AS items, MIN(occurred_at) AS first_seen, MAX(occurred_at) AS last_seen FROM {{all_events}} WHERE source_app = @caller_app AND occurred_at >= @from AND (@to IS NULL OR occurred_at < @to) GROUP BY event_type, action ORDER BY events DESC

reports.name: Daily event volume
reports.description: Events per calendar day for one app over a date range.
reports.sql: SELECT DATE(occurred_at) AS day, COUNT(*) AS events, SUM(item_count) AS items FROM {{all_events}} WHERE source_app = @caller_app AND occurred_at >= @from AND (@to IS NULL OR occurred_at < @to) GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

reports.name: Cross-app daily volume
reports.description: Events per day per app across every integrated app. Owner / cross-app credentials only.
reports.sql: SELECT DATE(occurred_at) AS day, source_app, domain, COUNT(*) AS events FROM {{all_events}} WHERE occurred_at >= @from AND (@to IS NULL OR occurred_at < @to) GROUP BY day, source_app, domain ORDER BY day, source_app, domain
